messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: AUTO-PAGE fired for inference-gateway-prod — alarm: gateway.5xx.rate — current: 1.8k 5xx/min (21% error rate). Pager: @oncall-sre.

morgan: ack — oncall SRE here, jumping on it.

pagerduty: Incident 87422 acknowledged by morgan. Escalation timer paused.

diego: seeing 502/504s from edge -> upstream kvcache timeouts around ~03:12 UTC. Not seeing a deploy in the window.

morgan: good call. can someone paste a quick log snippet?

diego: paste below — trimmed:

```
# tail -n 50 /var/log/gateway | grep "502\|504"
[03:12:12] gateway svc=inference-gateway req_id=abc status=504 upstream=kvcache-2 latency=1.45s msg="upstream timeout"
[03:12:34] gateway svc=inference-gateway req_id=def status=502 upstream=kvcache-1 latency=0.98s msg="bad gateway from upstream"
[03:13:01] gateway svc=inference-gateway req_id=ghi status=502 upstream=kvcache-3 latency=1.20s msg="upstream unhealthy"
```

tia: launching scale action now — bumping inference-gateway deployment from 12 -> 24 replicas. CMD: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-gateway --replicas=24 -n prod`

ops-bot: action queued: scale deployment inference-gateway -> 24 replicas (requested by tia).

morgan: also enabling regional fallback route for high-traffic customers (weight 30% -> regional-fallback-model). will throttle non-critical routes.

neha: customer-impact summary: ~23 customers show elevated errors, top affected: partner-api-prod (calls to /v1/predict) at 5% failure. Most calls are retried client-side; visible incidents in a few enterprise tenants. No confirmed SLO breach yet but trending.

diego: looking at kvcache pods — evictions spike at 03:11:50. TTLs look misaligned; cold-miss storm. Starting rolling restart kvcache-3 to clear stuck state.

morgan: can we temp-relax rate-limiter for trusted tokens to reduce 429+ upstream retries?

tia: doing that for the partner cohort now. patch: `api-gateway:rate_limit:trusted_tokens: limit=800r/m -> 1200r/m` (applied)

neha: notifying CS & impacted customers with a short note: "We’re investigating elevated 5xx on inference gateway; mitigation in progress. Will update in 15m."

pagerduty: Note: if incident not acknowledged by SRE lead in 10m, auto-escalate per policy.

morgan: quick health update — 03:22 UTC after scale + targeted kvcache restart, 5xx rate dropped ~55% vs peak. Still above baseline but trending down.

diego: confirming logs show fewer timeouts now, kvcache p99 latency improving from 1.2s -> 0.3s after restart. Hypothesis: cache TTL misconfig + sudden cold misses from dark-launch traffic spike.

morgan: mitigation list for post-incident: 1) tighten cache TTL hygiene + add gradual ramp for dark-launch traffic, 2) add circuit-breaker on kvcache upstream, 3) refine auto-scaling policy to react to upstream latencies not just cpu. Creating follow-up ticket PM-1423.

incidents-bot: Reminder: auto-resolve job scheduled in 15m if gateway.5xx.rate remains below threshold for 5 consecutive minutes.

morgan: handing off monitoring to night shift — @diego will watch for 25m then take post-incident. leaving note: tagged potential RCA hypothesis (cache cold-miss storm).

diego: taking handoff. will run continuous checks: 1) real-time error rate, 2) kvcache evictions, 3) deploy diff. Posting any deviation.

neha: sending out final customer update in 10m after confirming stable trend.

morgan: marking this thread as triaged, mitigation in place. assigning postmortem author neha + diego + tia. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: scaling completed: inference-gateway -> 24 replicas (done).

pagerduty: Incident 87422: monitoring. No further escalation.

incidents-bot: Thread closed for now — keep updates in this thread.

morgan: follow-up task: ensure dark-launch traffic ramp rule is adjusted to 5% per 10m window.

diego: noted. creating config change in infra repo and will include in PM-1423.

neha: thanks team — will draft customer-facing summary after postmortem.

morgan: logging final: mitigated -> monitoring, handoff to diego for night. Will reopen if error rate climbs back."
